Website information

Privacy & translation.

How contact enquiries and the Vietnamese translation are handled.

Contact enquiries

The contact form sends the information you enter to FormSubmit so it can be forwarded to hoang.nguyen@weltec.ac.nz. Your name, email, organisation, topic and message are used to respond to your enquiry. Do not include confidential research data or sensitive personal information.

The site itself does not maintain a contact database. FormSubmit may process and retain submissions under its own policies. Read FormSubmit’s privacy policy. You may also contact Hoang directly by email.

Vietnamese translation

English is the original language of this website. The VI link opens the current public page in Google Translate’s Vietnamese view. Google processes the page content to provide the translation; its interface and availability are controlled by Google. Machine translations may contain errors, particularly in scientific terminology. Refer to the English original for precise wording.

The translated view uses a Google service address and may display a translation toolbar. This website does not store a Vietnamese copy or a translation cache. Some regions, browsers or pages may not support translation. Google privacy policy.

Cookies and external links

This website includes no analytics scripts, advertising trackers or external font requests. Visiting external links, translating a page, or submitting the form may invoke third-party services and their cookie policies.
